title: Critic report (U10, R1983)
description: What a critic session answers with: the screens it graded and one issue per problem it sees, each citing a rubric rule (docs/design/rubric.md) and a region of one packet image. tools/mg critic rejects output that does not match this schema, cites a rule or image the packet does not have, or puts a region outside its image.

rubric_version.description: The rubric version the packet holds (rubric.md, 'Version N').

screens.description: Every screen id the packet lists, each graded.

notes.description: Anything the grading could not cover (a missing reference, an unreadable image).

variant.description: The image's variant as packet.json names it, e.g. dark-ax5-iphoneSmall+hc.

image.description: The packet path of the image the issue is seen in.

rule.description: A rule id of rubric.md, e.g. text-truncation.

severity.description: high keeps the screen out of verified; medium becomes a task; low is taste, recorded for the gallery (rubric.md, Severity).

region.description: The area of the image, in image pixels from its top-left corner.

summary.description: What is wrong, in one sentence a designer can act on.

evidence.description: What in the image shows it.
